jobs.title: Applied Scientist
jobs.jd: About Upstart At Upstart , we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstart ers the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. The Team Upstart ’s Machine Learning team applies machine learning and statistical methods to improve how we evaluate risk and make lending decisions. The team combines scientific research, experimentation, and engineering to develop models that support Upstart ’s mission of expanding access to affordable credit. As an Applied Scientist at Upstart , you will develop and evaluate machine learning models that address meaningful business problems. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, and cross-functional partners to translate complex data into modeling improvements and measurable outcomes. How you’ll make an impact Develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models to improve predictive performance and support lending decisions. Analyze large datasets to identify patterns, develop features, and inform modeling approaches. Design and execute experiments to assess model performance, validate hypotheses, and identify opportunities for improvement. Collaborate with scientists and engineers to implement, monitor, and refine models in production environments. Document methodologies, communicate findings, and contribute to reproducible scientific workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 0–2 years of experience in machine learning, applied statistics, or a related quantitative field. Experience developing or evaluating machine learning models using Python. Experience applying statistical methods, including hypothesis testing, regression, or predictive modeling, to quantitative datasets. Preferred Qualifications Advanced degree, ideally a PhD, in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, econometrics, operations research, computer science, or a related quantitative field. Knowledge of supervised learning techniques, model evaluation, and feature engineering. Familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Experience working with large-scale datasets using SQL or distributed data processing tools. Ability to communicate modeling approaches and experimental results to technical and nontechnical audiences. Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time. At Upstart , your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Product
jobs.jd:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Mirakl Assistant team, led by Remi Takase, Senior Data Science Manager. The team is part of a passionate and skilled data organisation of Data Scientists, Research Scientists, Data Engineers and SREs, building on a state-of-the-art Machine Learning and Data platform. The Mirakl Assistant team is a new team that runs like a start-up inside a scale-up. Together, you'll be designing, building and scaling the conversational AI assistant that changes how our users work across Mirakl products.

The assistant knows the platform and the users, and helps them get the most out of Mirakl, from finding their way around the product, to understanding their business and growing it. We're taking it from conversational to action-oriented: users ask, and the assistant gets it done.

AI agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software: what customers expect from it, how they interact with it, and how they integrate it into their business. At Mirakl, AI is a core part of our product strategy - from Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce. This is where you come in.

The position is a permanent contract, based in Paris or Bordeaux, with up to 1 day of remote work per week. 

2. Your Impact

  • Design, build and scale the core capabilities of the Mirakl Assistant, including RAG, LLM orchestration, tool use, memory and context engineering, from rapid prototype to robust production feature
  • Own the full production lifecycle of the assistant: automated data pipelines, CI/CD, deployment, load testing, latency and resilience
  • Run technical discovery and feasibility studies for new capabilities and integrations across Mirakl products
  • Drive quality improvement through rigorous offline and online evaluation, data-driven experimentation and iteration
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Software, Data Engineering, SRE and Product teams to evolve the agentic foundations and translate user needs into capabilities

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software engineering skills, or as a Software/Data Engineer with hands-on AI and ML experience
  • Proven track record of deploying AI/ML systems in production products, with an automation-first approach
  • Proven experience building AI agents with LLMs, RAG, MCP and related technologies, including architectural design
  • Strong experience in data-driven iteration, from experimentation to evaluation

Skills:

  • LLM orchestration and agentic systems design (RAG, MCP, LangChain, etc.)
  • Software engineering proficiency in Python
  • Solid grounding in machine learning algorithms and fundamental
  • Rigorous metrics-driven evaluation and experimentation
  • A "0 to 1" mindset: able to thrive in ambiguity and take an idea from exploration to production
  • Product sense: understanding end users’ pain points and balancing technical excellence with customer impact 
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Frontend development (TypeScript, React) is a plus

4. Tech Stack

  • Languages: Python, SQL, TypeScript
  • Backend: FastAPI, LangChain, OpenSearch, Kafka, PostgreSQL
  • Frontend: React (micro-frontend architecture)
  • AI: LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
  • Data Platform & Orchestration:<

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About Us: Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come. About the Role We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to help us build and ship AI-powered features that directly improve our product experience and business outcomes. This is a hands-on, product-focused role where you'll take ideas from concept to production — designing intelligent systems, validating them with real users, and turning them into reliable, scalable services. You'll work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering — partnering closely with cross-functional teams to identify high-impact opportunities, prototype quickly, and iterate based on data. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own the full lifecycle: experimentation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate is excited about applying LLMs and modern ML tooling to real-world problems. You think in terms of systems, tradeoffs, and outcomes — not just models. You care about performance, quality, latency, and cost in production. Most importantly, you're motivated by shipping impactful AI experiences that customers actually use. What You'll Do Build and ship AI agents that serve real users: tool-calling LLM systems with structured output, parallel API orchestration, and streaming responses. Design evaluation harnesses and quality scoring — we use Langfuse, rubrics to measure safety, effectiveness, and personalization. Own the full loop: prototype a new agent capability, validate it with evals, deploy it to staging and production, monitor traces, and iterate. Improve reliability, latency, and cost through prompt caching strategies, token budgets, retry logic, and observability. Write the tools agents use: API integrations with Pydantic validation, exercise search over local databases, structured workout submission. What You Bring Strong Python skills: you've built and deployed services on large production systems. Experience with LangChain/LangGraph or similar agent frameworks. Hands-on experience with LLMs in production: prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured output, evaluation. Comfort with async Python, HTTP APIs, and streaming protocols (SSE, webhooks). Experience with data validation and schema design (Pydantic, JSON Schema). Ability to debug across layers: from a broken LLM tool call to a misconfigured Terraform resource. Clear communication: you'll work directly with product, mobile, and backend engineers. Nice to Have Familiarity with AWS (Bedrock, ECR, CloudFront, S3, Cognito) or other cloud agent hosting. Observability and tracing tools (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Datadog). Exposure to evaluation frameworks: LLM-as-a-judge, automated scoring, dataset management. Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK). Compensation & Benefits We believe great people should be well paid and meaningfully invested in what they're building. Base Salary $ 215,000– $ 250,000/ year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Equity Equity participation offered alongside base compensation. Health Coverage Comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance plus tax savings accounts for all eligible employees. Retirement 401(k) plan with tax-advantaged savings options. Remote-First Employment eligible to all employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required. Wellness & Development Monthly health and fitness stipend contributing to overall wellbeing, access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend. Flexible Time Off Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work. Future Membership Enjoy our platform for free! Life at Future Equity: Meaningful equity package. Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts. Retirement: 401(k) plan. Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support. jobs.title: AI Engineer, DevEx & Automation
jobs.jd:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Agentic Developer Experience Engineering team led by Benoit Lateltin, AI Transformation Program Lead.

The team currently consists of 3 Software Engineers, 100% dedicated to building the agentic tooling powering all of Mirakl Labs. Together, you'll be designing, shipping and running AI agents and assistants that transform how 330+ engineers, Product Managers, Designers and QAs work every day.

Please note this role requires to be based 4 days at the office, per week.

Your Impact

  • Build agents and assistants as products - across the full software development lifecycle (code review, tech design, maintenance, incident response), from first prototype to tools teams genuinely rely on every day.
  • Define and expand AI delegation safely - set the human control points, guardrails and evaluation frameworks; measure the autonomy rate per task type and extend what agents handle as trust builds over time.
  • Turn team pain points into working software - sit with engineers, PMs, QAs and designers to find the real friction, prototype fast, pilot with volunteer squads, and scale what works.
  • Build the knowledge infrastructure agents consume - along with tooling for usage, cost and impact monitoring, leveraging the Data & Agentic Platform and DevExp foundations rather than rebuilding them from scratch.
  • Make every product measurable - adoption rate, time saved, quality, cost: nothing ships without its metrics.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, Developer Productivity, or related fields
  • Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, with experience building reliable, maintainable and production-ready systems
  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-powered products, using LLMs, RAG and AI Agents
  • Experience applying AI to software development workflows, such as code review, technical design, testing, documentation, maintenance or incident response
  • Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and integrating developer tools, code repositories, CI/CD pipelines, issue trackers or documentation platforms
  • Experience evaluating AI systems and improving their reliability, quality and level of autonomy, through appropriate evaluation frameworks and human-in-the-loop mechanisms
  • Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments
  • Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate closely with engineers and cross-functional teams
  • Curiosity, pragmatism and a strong product mindset, with a passion for turning real developer pain points into useful AI-powered solutions
  • Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can better understand what you have built and worked on!

 

Tech Stack

  • Java, Python, TypeScript
  • Agentic stack: Coding Agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, pi.dev) , MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-source models), evaluation frameworks
  • Infrastructure: GitHub Actions/CI, Kubernetes, Datadog

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application. This helps us make the best poss

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer, you will own the delivery of scoped customer implementations and help turn real-world business needs into production-grade agentic automation solutions . You’ll partner closely with customer stakeholders and internal teams to design, build, integrate, and iterate on AI-enabled workflows, balancing speed, reliability, and maintainability. You’ll contribute practical field insights back to the organization, helping refine solution patterns, reusable assets, and implementation playbooks. Unlike traditional software engineers who build a single product for many customers, FDEs ship tailored solutions directly in customer environments, making the platform real for specific business processes and systems. You’ll operate with increasing independence, drive execution on well-defined workstreams , and collaborate with senior FDEs and product teams to align with broader technical direction. What you'll do at UiPath Design and build AI-driven workflows, agents, and automations, aligned with UiPath's architecture and platform standards without requiring regular guidance. Build AI Agents using UiPath technologies, including Maestro or Agent Builder Apply practical prompt engineering skills to reliably guide agent behavior and understand model tradeoffs (capability, latency, cost) when selecting LLM providers for customer use cases. Extend platform functionality using APIs, SDKs, and connectors to address unique customer requirements. Debug across systems including AI inference, data pipelines, orchestration layers, and integration points, resolving most issues independently. Contribute to internal libraries, reusable components, or frameworks that enhance consistency across customer deployments. Anticipate delivery risks and communicate blockers, delays, and scope issues proactively to teammates and stakeholders. Use telemetry, insights, and traces to identify optimization opportunities and failure patterns independently. What you'll bring to the team 5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent) delivering production software. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript (or similar modern languages). Experience building and shipping integrations using APIs and working with cloud services or enterprise systems. Comfort operating in customer-facing environments with strong written and verbal communication. Ability to independently drive scoped projects, manage risks, and deliver against deadlines. Willingness to travel to customer sites as needed. Our core principles Customer Centric: Stay close to customer users and stakeholders; anchor decisions in outcomes, adoption, and long-term success. Breaking Silos: Collaborate across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customer teams to unblock delivery and align on the right solution. Improving Agility: Prototype, test, ship, observe, and iterate—treat deployments and feedback loops as the fastest way to learn. Dealing with Ambiguity: Make progress with incomplete information; clarify requirements through discovery, iteration, and pragmatic tradeoffs. Building Focus: Prioritize the highest-impact workstreams, manage scope actively, and deliver durable solutions that customers can run and evolve. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned. Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy . At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

jobs.title: Research Data Scientist
jobs.jd: 🪐 Discover our galaxy Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different: - A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries - A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth - Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI - A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐 Explore your future career 🔭 We are looking for a Research Data Scientist to take ownership of Marketplace Economics and Public Thought Leadership within our specialized Research team, reporting directly to Marc Palyart (Director of ML). Working alongside two Machine Learning Researchers, you will be Malt's go to expert in applied economics and causal inference. You will combine rigorous econometric methods with a pragmatic, product and business oriented mind modeling two-sided marketplace dynamics (liquidity, fee elasticity, supply-demand balance, search frictions) to directly improve product conversion. Some of the questions you might explore : - How is the freelancing market evolving in time ? What drives supply and demand in freelance markets, and how do workers and companies respond to changing economic conditions? - What makes a market place efficient and what are the frictions that prevent beneficial matches ? How to solve these frictions ? - How do prices, platform fees, and supply and demand elasticities shape marketplace dynamics and participants' behavior? Key responsibilities ✨ Marketplace Economics : Investigate the economic mechanisms driving marketplace dynamics, supply-demand imbalances, liquidity, pricing elasticity, and matching efficiency. Applied Causal Inference & Experimentation: Formulate falsifiable economic hypotheses, design quasi-experimental and experimental setups (Diff-in-Diff, Instrumental Variables, Fixed Effects), and isolate true causal mechanisms within complex, multi-sided platform interactions. External Research & Flagship Thought Leadership: Co-author Malt’s research publications as well as macroeconomic barometers in close partnership with Marketing, translating raw platform telemetry into compelling public narratives for industry leaders and tier-1 media. Cross-Functional Strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with Product, ML, Marketing, and C-Suite stakeholders to identify high-impact research questions, challenge assumptions, and uncover underlying economic mechanisms. Hands-On Data Engineering & Modeling: Write clean SQL on BigQuery and engineer robust, reproducible analytical pipelines in Python, leveraging modern AI-assisted tools to maximize research velocity. About you 🧑‍🚀 Academic Foundation: PhD (or Master's degree with equivalent proven empirical research track record) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Social Sciences, or a related empirical discipline. Strong Quantitative and Research Background Empirical Econometrics & Modeling: Proven expertise in microeconomic modeling, causal inference, and empirical identification strategies (e.g., panel data, Instrumental Variables, Diff-in-Diff, selection models). Applied Research Mindset: You combine scientific rigor with a pragmatic approach to solving real-world economic problems. You know how to adapt your methods and the depth of your analyses to the question at hand. Hands-On Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, Statsmodels, SciPy) and high-level SQL on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Google BigQuery, Snowflake). Stakeholder Fluency: Exceptional ability to scope ambiguous problems, communicate complex econometric findings to non-technical leaders, and constructively challenge stakeholder assumptions. Full professional proficiency in English. If you're excited about using unique marketplace data to explore meaningful economic questions, shape real-world decisions, and contribute to a deeper understanding of the future of work, we'd love to hear from you! Research discussion with your future colleagues to walk through two pieces of work: a research project of your choice, and one proposed by us. jobs.jd: Your contribution to something big: You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on developing machine learning and AI solutions to predict and optimize energy consumption in residential heating systems. You will work across the full AI lifecycle, from data collection and feature engineering to model development, validation, and deployment. You will also explore Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI Agents to develop intelligent applications and automate engineering workflows, collaborating closely with R&D, thermal simulation, controls, and software teams. Your main responsibilities will be: Machine Learning Development: Design, develop, and validate machine learning models to predict residential heating system energy consumption, including hourly consumption, peak loads, and longer-term energy demand. Data Engineering & Feature Development: Work with sensor data, weather information, building characteristics, occupancy data, and other relevant sources to prepare datasets and develop meaningful features. Data Quality & Analysis: Clean and analyse complex sensor and IoT datasets, identifying missing or inconsistent data and addressing seasonal effects and changes in operating conditions. Modeling & Forecasting: Develop and compare different approaches, including regression, time-series forecasting, gradient boosting, neural networks, physics-informed models, and hybrid solutions. Generative AI & AI Agents: Explore and develop AI applications using LLMs, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents to support data analysis, knowledge extraction, intelligent automation, and engineering workflows. Model Validation & Optimization: Evaluate and continuously improve ML and AI solutions through experimentation, error analysis, performance evaluation, and robustness testing. ML/AI Deployment & Monitoring: Support the integration of ML and AI solutions into production environments, contributing to monitoring, model performance evaluation, and continuous improvement. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with thermal modelling, HVAC, controls, and software engineers to translate complex engineering challenges into data science and AI solutions. Technical Guidance & Documentation: Support junior team members and document modelling approaches, AI architectures, results, assumptions, and technical trade-offs. What distinguishes you: Experience: Around 3 years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Machine Learning: Good knowledge of machine learning, statistical methods, and predictive modelling, including regression, classification, and time-series forecasting. Generative AI & LLMs: Knowledge or practical experience with LLMs, Generative AI applications, prompt engineering, and RAG. AI Agents : Understanding AI agent architectures and the integration of LLMs with external tools, APIs, and data sources is a plus. Programming: Strong Python skills and experience with tools such as scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or AI development frameworks. Data Analysis: Experience working with complex datasets, including data cleaning, feature engineering, and analysis. Experience with sensor or IoT data is a plus. ML/AI Deployment: Understanding of model deployment, monitoring, and MLOps/LLMOps concepts. Technical Knowledge: Experience with time-series forecasting, physics-informed ML, HVAC/thermal systems, or IoT applications is considered an advantage. Problem Solving & Collaboration: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, good communication skills, and ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering and software teams. Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. Position description At Sonar, we are seeking an innovative Research Engineer to join our Data & Agentic team and pioneer the next generation of our code analysis and verification engines. You will be at the forefront of applying cutting-edge AI, advanced agentic workflow and static analysis techniques to complex source code. Your work will directly shape our core products—ensuring both AI-generated and developer-written code meets rigorous enterprise quality and security standards. If you are driven to turn state-of-the-art research into practical, high-impact solutions, this is the role for you. Brainstorm novel ways to improve our products and provide immediate, practical feedback to steer exploratory research toward paths that are both impactful and engineering-feasible. Develop Agentic Workflows : Design, prototype, and validate intelligent agentic systems and automated workflows that facilitate writing clean code, identifying root causes of system issues, and remediating complex bugs and vulnerabilities. Develop Pragmatic Prototypes: Build hands-on prototypes that prove the viability and scalability of research concepts. Proactively identify engineering bottlenecks or scalability limits and propose effective mitigations early in the research phase. Evaluate & Benchmark: Drive the rigorous evaluation of new product features. Engineer Data Pipelines : Build and manage robust data pipelines to gather, process, and version massive code-centric datasets required for training and evaluating specialized models at scale. Translate Prototypes to Products : Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base. Communicate and Evangelize : Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience and qualifications Must have: Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages. Practical experience with modern agentic frameworks, software automation tools, and LLM architectures. Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy. Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our team in Brazil or Argentina. We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live. About the role: As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you'll become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experience of tomorrow. The company builds software for commercial real estate. This isn't general cloud engineering, you will actually built agentic-platform infrastructure before, not just traditional cloud architecture. Responsibilities: Model Design & Delivery Design, train and ship production ML models for real estate and facilities decisions, such as forecasting for space, occupancy, headcount, rent and finances Own each model end to end: problem framing, data and features, training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and cost and latency budgets Serve models as versioned, documented APIs that product features, agents and other systems call. Keep the serving layer portable across cloud platforms, for example by using containers Contribute to embedding and retrieval work, and measure retrieval quality on real customer documents Contribute to synthetic data pipelines, so teams can develop and test without production customer data. Measure how closely the synthetic data matches the real data, how well models trained on it perform, and whether it leaks private data Evaluation, Quality & Trust Own the evaluation of every model you ship: backtests, held-out datasets, metrics that fit the problem, and regression suites in CI that gate releases Build them on the shared evaluation framework that the platform team provides Find the root cause of quality failures, whether data drift, leakage, a feature defect, flawed ground truth, a retrieval miss or a model regression. Fix the layer that is at fault Monitor production models for accuracy, drift, silent degradation and cost Retrain or roll back based on evidence Own model-level safety behavior: keep customer data within each tenant’s access rules, handle PII correctly, test for privacy leakage, and disclose uncertainty clearly Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Product to turn accuracy thresholds and confidence disclosure into shipped behavior Agree on API contracts, accuracy bars and failure behavior with the teams that build AI agents on your models. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment and with Data Platform on the curated datasets and features your models read Feed model performance and usage data into the warehouse, so model quality is measurable next to product analytics Support the domain teams that build on your models, contribute to the shared quality standard for models and agents, and mentor engineers on ML practice Requirements: You have taken at least one ML model from problem framing to production, and kept it accurate through retraining and drift. Typically 5+ years of professional engineering experience and a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience Python and SQL, including the ML stack (scikit-learn, PyTorch or equivalent, pandas or equivalent) and the service stack (FastAPI, Pydantic or equivalent) Testing, code review, CI/CD and production ownership. You use AI coding assistants and verify their output Hands-on experience with ML evaluation: time-aware validation and backtesting against simple baselines, holdout design, metric selection, interval coverage and calibration, error analysis, and using results to gate releases. jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist , Amazon Leo Networking Software
jobs.jd: Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite broadband network to deliver fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world, including those underserved by traditional infrastructure. Operating a live constellation and its ground network at scale means service disruptions are an inevitable reality, and how quickly we detect them, understand them, and prevent them from recurring defines the trust we earn as a connectivity provider. We are seeking a talented Senior Data Scientist to build the next generation of observability and availability science for the Leo network. Leo already detects outages, notifies affected customers, and restores service. The frontier is prediction and prevention: reasoning over complex network and ground-segment telemetry to autonomously detect anomalies before they reach customers, attribute root cause automatically across a sprawling event surface, and rationalize a large, still-maturing metric set so responders trust what the system tells them. In this role you will work backwards from the needs of customers and operations teams. You will own the scientific direction end to end, partnering closely with network engineers, the Network Operations Center, and the Incident Management team, and the Software and Networking orginization to translate a long-term science vision into concrete research and delivery roadmaps. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities * Own the observability and availability science end to end, from long-term vision to research roadmap to production delivery, working backwards from the needs of customers, the NOC, and network engineering. * Develop time-series and graph-based models with dynamic baselining that detect network and ground-segment anomalies before they cross the High Severity threshold, enabling proactive investigation rather than reactive response. * Reason over complex, multi-system telemetry to attribute cause automatically during live HSEs and LSEs, so Call Leaders and engineers spend time mitigating, not hunting. * Provide the science behind the network's bucketed availability decomposition (geometric and satellite coverage, ground and network segments, customer terminals, payload, and planning), attributing every movement to a true cause rather than noise, so leadership steers on signal and engineering effort lands where it actually moves availability and throughput. * Deliver the models, analyses, and metrics that feed the daily system readiness and validation review consumed by senior leadership and product and engineering, turning availability and throughput data into a defensible, evidence-based read on progress against GA entry criteria. * Own the recurring, fleet-wide "hot topic" investigations that span ASIC, firmware, payload, network, and planning, separating correlated symptoms from true root cause across thousands of nodes, quantifying how much availability or throughput each is costing, and answering whether it is a launch-blocking risk and whether it is improving. * Deliver alert correlation and deduplication, false-positive reduction, and metric-quality scoring so responders trust what the system tells them, directly supporting a large, still-maturing KPI set. * Tie your science to the unit the org actually measures: reduce detection and attribution time, raise availability against the network's bar, and increase the share of events prevented before customer impact. * Partner day to day with the Network Operations Center, Network Engineering, and the Incident Management (Call Leader) program; sit on live HSE/LSE bridges as the science partner and turn event learnings into model improvements. * Feed COEs and RCAs back into detection and attribution so recurring signatures are caught earlier, and help design and score gamedays that stress-test both the network and your models against real, closed events. * Build and deploy production pipelines on AWS (e.g., SageMaker, Bedrock, Glue) with model validation, monitoring, drift detection, and explainability, because operations teams must be able to trust and act on model output under pressure. * Set data-science standards, mentor scientists, and drive best practices across the Leo networking organization as the science function scales. * Produce explainable output and written narratives that let responders and leaders three or more levels up act on your models during and between events. A day in the life You might start by reviewing overnight anomaly detections and availability movements, join an HSE bridge as the science partner by midday, and spend the afternoon refining root-cause attribution models or presenting availability findings at the readiness review. About the team Amazon Leo Networking Software builds and operates the software behind Leo's satellite and ground network. Our science function partners with the NOC, Network Engineering and Incident Management to make the network more available and resilient, moving from reacting to outages to predicting and preventing them. As a Data Scientist III, you'll help shape that function as it grows. - 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 4+ years of data scientist experience - Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression - 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience - Experience managing data pipelines - Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Trust & Safety
jobs.jd:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

You’ll join the Detection subdomain within Trust & Safety, whose mission is to protect the Vinted community by identifying harmful content and activities. We build detection capabilities that enable timely prevention and moderation, reducing members’ exposure to harm, while minimising disruption to legitimate members.

You’ll develop and improve machine learning models that identify harmful listings and suspicious behaviour across the marketplace, while minimising friction on legitimate members. Working with text, images and behavioural data, you’ll apply practical machine learning techniques to evolving detection challenges.

You’ll work closely with Data Scientists, Decision Scientists, Product Managers and engineers to turn ideas into reliable production solutions. You’ll take ownership of well-defined projects across the ML lifecycle, from understanding the data and developing models to deployment, evaluation and ongoing maintenance.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Develop, evaluate and improve machine learning models that detect harmful content and behaviour at scale.
  • Engineer features, prepare training and evaluation datasets, understanding their limitations and addressing issues such as noisy labels, class imbalance and data leakage.
  • Collaborate with engineers to integrate models into production and develop reliable training and inference pipelines using established tooling.
  • Work with Decision Scientists and Product Managers to define success metrics and evaluate model improvements through offline analysis and online experimentation, balancing detection coverage with false positives and member experience.
  • Monitor deployed models, investigate changes in their effectiveness and improve them as harmful behaviour and underlying data evolve.
  • Write reliable, maintainable and reproducible code, document your work, share learnings and contribute ideas to the team’s roadmap.

About you

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Integrity
jobs.jd: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI’s Integrity team protects people and businesses using ChatGPT, Codex, and the API from fraud, abuse, and harmful misuse. Our work spans payment and promotional abuse, compromised accounts and API credentials, business and advertiser integrity, and emerging misuse of frontier AI capabilities. We also help product teams measure authentic usage so that abuse doesn’t distort decisions about how our products are growing. Integrity Data Science helps teams decide where to intervene and whether those interventions work. A payment control can prevent fraud while blocking legitimate purchases. A product launch can make it easier for customers to get started while creating new opportunities for abuse. We measure both sides of those decisions. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Data Scientist on Integrity, you’ll find emerging abuse patterns, size their impact, and lead the analytical work behind decisions about detection, enforcement, and product launches. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Research, Policy, and Operations to turn findings into improvements and measure what happens after they ship. - Investigate anomalous activity across products. Estimate how common a problem is, who is affected, and what it costs users or the business. Use that evidence to recommend where to focus. - Define outcome metrics and guardrails, establish baselines, and build monitoring that surfaces changes in abuse, customer friction, and operational performance. - Help build and evaluate detection rules, classifiers, and human review workflows. Use labeled samples and review outcomes to understand what the systems miss, where they flag legitimate activity, and how those errors vary across users and products. - Design randomized holdouts and use quasi-experimental or observational methods when randomization is impractical. Estimate harm or fraud losses prevented alongside effects on legitimate users, revenue, compute costs, and review workload. Recommend whether to launch, expand, adjust, or retire a control. - Trace where signals, review decisions, or enforcement actions break down. Work with partners to close gaps and build reusable datasets, analyses, and investigation tools. IDEAL CANDIDATE - You use AI tools to investigate large, messy datasets, test hypotheses quickly, and automate recurring analyses. You’re fluent in SQL and Python and can verify AI-generated queries, code, and conclusions against the underlying data. - You have strong statistical judgment and experience with experimentation, causal inference, or observational analysis. You can reason from incomplete or biased labels and explain how uncertainty affects a decision. - You take ownership of open-ended problems, from deciding what to measure through recommending an action and checking whether it worked. - You communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical partners and can explain the tradeoffs behind a recommendation. - Experience in integrity, trust and safety, fraud or risk analytics, security analytics, or applied ML evaluation is helpful. Experience evaluating detection systems, human review, or LLM-based classifiers is a plus. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.jd: ABOUT RAMP Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. ABOUT RAMP LABS Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000+ companies use to move money. ABOUT THE ROLE Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map-reduce, long-running fan-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step - Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping - Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output - Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine-tuned models where they hold up - Turn one-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack - Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works WHAT YOU NEED - Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped - Hands-on experience with multi-agent or high-fan-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map-reduce over models, large batch inference - Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production - Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look like before you scale the swarm, and you can separate signal from agent noise - The habit of measuring: cost, yield, false-positive rate, and whether a change actually helped - Ownership: you can run a roadmap and a production system with little oversight - Clear written communication NICE-TO-HAVE - Built agent orchestration or job systems (Ray, Temporal, Modal or custom) - Used LLMs to search large spaces: codebases, document sets, logs or other large corpora - Post-training or hosting open-source models for high-volume inference - Distributed systems background - Public work we can look at: an agent framework, an open-source project, a write-up or a paper BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL) - Flexible PTO - Centralized home-office equipment ordering - Health and wellness stipend - Budget for intra-office travel - Weekly coffee stipend UNITED STATES - 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents - One Medical annual membership - 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp - Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year) - Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay - jobs.title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
jobs.jd: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer. - Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI. - Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes). - Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis. - Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel. Bonus - Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product. - Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers. - Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access. Growth potential We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role: - Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales. - Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI). - Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Our scope is broad: NLP, anomaly detection, graph learning, and large language models. Your role: Build scalable machine learning systems to preserve the trust and safety of our players. Our motto is to never stop at the prototyping phase — we combine research and engineering cycles with the objective of deploying production-grade products that have a real impact at scale. You will tackle hard problems at the intersection of NLP, anomaly detection, graph learning, and LLMs. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with proven production experience, someone comfortable moving fluidly between research and engineering. Missions: The archetypal missions for this position would be to: Design, train, and deploy ML models across a range of player safety and security use cases, spanning NLP, anomaly detection, and graph-based learning. Evaluate and implement state-of-the-art ML techniques — adapting the latest research in deep learning, NLP, and graph learning to production constraints, implementing from scratch when needed. Take full ownership of the projects you build: interact with stakeholders, define success metrics, monitor live systems, and iterate. Write, optimise, and ship high-quality code that runs at scale, applying modern MLOps best practices (CI/CD, model versioning, observability). In collaboration with data and software engineers, deliver models and prediction pipelines to production on our internal or public cloud infrastructures. Strong Python software engineering skills: clean code, testing, documentation, CI/CD. Proven experience deploying and monitoring production ML models (MLOps, model serving, drift monitoring). Hands-on experience with NLP / LLMs: fine-tuning transformer models, prompt engineering, RAG, or LLM-based pipelines. Experience with graph-based ML (GNNs) is a strong plus. Knowledge of anomaly detection or fraud/trust & safety systems in a production context. Experience with distributed data processing (Spark) and cloud data platforms; familiarity with Databricks (DAB, Delta Live Tables) or Azure-specific services is a plus. Strong communication skills; English is mandatory (presentations, cross-team collaboration, reporting). Ideal candidate: experience with token classification (NER, sequence labelling) and/or hands-on GNN training (node classification, link prediction, graph construction pipelines). jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: AI Catalog
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.
  • Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.
  • Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution, they provide the core harness for GitLab’s agents, the tools Agent’s need to interact with GitLab as well as ways to configure and execute Agents across GitLab.

Our engineers work async-first across EMEA and AMER timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: AI Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Hoe lang duurt dit ziekteverzuim? Hoeveel stroom levert het windpark morgen? Welke klant staat open voor een volgend product? Organisaties willen het antwoord weten voordat het zover is. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer zorg jij dat die voorspelling er komt: betrouwbaar, herhaalbaar en verankerd in het werk van echte gebruikers. De uitdaging Generatieve AI trekt de aandacht, maar predictive AI levert vaak de harde waarde. De twee lossen verschillende problemen op en versterken elkaar. Jij weet welke aanpak bij welk vraagstuk past, en waar de grenzen liggen. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer kom je in dienst bij LINKIT en ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers , zoals overheden, ASML, InsingerGilissen en KLM. Daar tref je vaak data waar nog veel meer uit te halen valt. Jij maakt er producten op basis van AI van die werken. Je werk bestaat onder meer uit: Statistische analyses en dataverkenning om haalbaarheid en aanpak snel helder te krijgen. Data pipelines bouwen en de juiste featureset samenstellen voor modeltraining. Modellen ontwikkelen, van gradient boosting tot deep learning. Modelregistratie, experiment tracking en modelvisualisaties op orde houden. Modellen ontsluiten via FastAPI, zodat ze aanroepbaar zijn binnen het bestaande applicatielandschap. Met coding agents vind je sneller de juiste libraries en creeër je inzicht zodat de haalbaarheid en juiste aanpak snel boven water komen. Je adviseert gebruikers en stakeholders over wat AI wel en niet kan. Je werkt pragmatisch en zet door tot de mensen voor wie je modellen bedoeld zijn ze dagelijks gebruiken. Je plek Je sluit aan bij de AI& Data Squad: Explorers die al jaren AI toepassen en elkaar scherp houden. AI is voor LINKIT een strategisch speerpunt waar we de komende jaren flink in investeren. Onze ambitie is dé partij voor integere AI-oplossingen in Nederland te worden. Daarvoor bouwen we aan nieuwe proposities, van verantwoorde AI op Europese infrastructuur tot voorspelmodellen op Databricks. Jij denkt daar actief over mee. Om de twee weken kom je op vrijdag met alle Explorers samen op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de clubdag: een dag voor kennisdelen, leren en verbinden. Lees hier meer over de AI squad. Wat we vragen Minimaal 4 jaar werkervaring als ontwikkelaar, waarvan minimaal 2 jaar met AI en machine learning. Een stevige basis in data science of software engineering. Ervaring met modellen en frameworks zoals LightGBM, XGBoost en Keras. Ervaring met platformen als Azure ML, Databricks, AWS SageMaker of GCP Vertex AI. Ervaring met pandas, polars of Spark, en met exploratie in Jupyter en Seaborn. Ervaring met tracking en orkestratie via MLflow, Prefect of Airflow. Je kunt onderbouwen welk model of welke tool in welke situatie het beste werkt, en je maakt je nieuwe tools snel eigen. Je volgt generatieve AI op de voet, van prompt via context naar harness engineering, en weet hoe je oplossingen met LLM’s evalueert, monitort en verbetert. Voldoe je niet aan elk punt, maar wel nieuwsgierig? Dan komen we alsnog graag met je in contact. Wat je krijgt Salaris tussen €4.000 - €7.900 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis & ervaring) + 8% vakantiegeld. Dit is een brede range omdat wij zowel op zoek zijn naar medior als senior Engineers. Jaarlijkse winstdeling en pensioenregeling. Hybride werken: op ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, bij de klant of vanuit huis. 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om tijdelijk vanuit het buitenland te werken. Elektrische leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding. Netto thuiswerkvergoeding, een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een laptop en telefoon, die je ook privé kunt gebruiken. Om de twee weken op vrijdag komen alle collega’s terug naar ons hoofdkantoor in De Meern, dan investeren wij tot 10% van jouw werktijd in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden (dit noemen wij de clubdag). Extra’s zoals onbeperkt opleidingsbudget, dagelijkse verse lunch, jaarlijks wintersport en wellbeing-activiteiten, zoals een wijnproeverij en yoga. Sollicitatieprocedure We willen je leren kennen en jij ons. Daarom houden we het persoonlijk en concreet. Kennismaking: Een eerste gesprek over wie je bent, wat je drijft en of er een match is. Een assignment die je thuis maakt waarin jij jouw kennis en ervaring op een leuke manier kan toepassen en we iets concreets te bespreken hebben Verdiepende gesprekken: Twee gesprekken over je gemaakte assignment, ervaring, werkwijze en hoe jij past binnen de squad en bij onze klanten. Aanbieding: Als het klikt, volgt een concreet aanbod. Vragen vooraf? Neem gerust contact op met Raoel via Over ons LINKIT is opgericht in 1998 en gegroeid van IT-bemiddelaar naar kennisgedreven IT-organisatie, met ruim 250 Explorers uit meer dan 25 nationaliteiten. We werken voor grote organisaties in overheid, finance en logistiek als partner die meedenkt van vraagstuk tot oplossing. Als AI Machine Learning Engineer ga je aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers, met een contract bij LINKIT. Je bepaalt je eigen richting, met een ongelimiteerd opleidingsbudget en de ruimte om te groeien op een manier die bij jou past. Rethink it with LINKIT. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd:
Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

Overview

We are looking for an exceptional full-stack software engineer who will act as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, accelerated adoption of AI-assisted SDLC practices, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Modernization Execution: Embed with application teams to provide hands-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud-native architectures.
  • AI-First SDLC Adoption & Upskilling: Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI-assisted software development practices into the team’s daily workflow.
  • Consultative Engineering & Change Management: Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change.
  • Hands-on Software Development: Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team.
  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities.
  • Standards & Quality: Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high-quality coding standards.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization.
  • Full Stack Proficiency: Strong hands-on experience across the full application stack (front-end, back-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C#, Java).
  • Cloud Native & IaC: Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
  • Consulting & Change Management: Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams.
  • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices.
  • Architectural Understanding: Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders effectively.

Preferred Skills (A Plus)

  • Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization.
  • Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies.
  • Hands-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar.
  • Experience utilizing AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda).

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer

Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an AI Research Engineer to join the HAIL team. HAIL (HRT AI Labs) is the team at HRT responsible for developing and maintaining our most powerful models, which are used by our trading teams to drive a significant fraction of our trading. We are building and deploying "foundation models for markets", that ingest and train on vast amounts of market and “alternative” data (such as language) to make predictions about future market state.

As a research engineer on HAIL, you will have a general mandate to improve all aspects of large-scale model training, including but not limited to kernel development, training data loading, parallelism, networking, and fault-tolerance. You will work closely with our researchers to co-design and improve our models, and shape the research agenda.

We have multiple large, modern, and rapidly growing GPU clusters, and we maintain a very high GPU-to-researcher ratio. We are simultaneously pursuing multiple strategies and developing many model types with different purposes, and we are strongly incentivized to squeeze as much as we can out of our systems. Your work will be directly, clearly, and highly impactful on the business, and it will be challenging: this is a field with no easy or obvious solutions.

Qualifications

  • Strong engineering skills, especially any of: CUDA/Triton/Pallas/CuTe DSL kernel development, lower-level PyTorch/JAX/XLA development, CUDA Graphs, FPGA/ASIC experience
  • Must have two or more years work experience building deep learning systems, for any domain: language, speech, robotics, biology, chemistry, physics, audio, video, recommendations, etc.
